items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Five titled sections with h2 and a visible label.label above every field, but the fields sit in a two-column grid (grid sm:grid-cols-2 in every section), so it is not a single column.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Required labels carry *; sidebar states 'Fields marked * are required'; Pronouns says '(optional)'; other optional fields (Preferred name, Probation) are unmarked.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Types are right (type=email, tel, date, number) but .field is width:100% in half-width grid cells, so date of birth, ZIP (#zip), routing and SSN (#tax) are all as wide as the name fields.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: Button #save 'Save draft' is type=button and its handler writes values to sessionStorage with no validation.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: The action row is a normal div at the end of the form (border-t pt-6), not sticky or fixed; there is no Cancel button at all. 'Add employee' is a verb and not disabled.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: Only native HTML validation bubbles; no blur handlers, no error summary, no inline messages. The only custom code is an end-date check and an 'invalid' listener that scrolls to the section.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: No beforeunload handler in the script; the 'Unsaved changes' text is only a status label.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Dropzone text 'PDF, JPG, PNG · Up to 10 MB each'; renderFiles() builds rows with a button aria-label 'Remove <name>'; input #files is a real sr-only file input inside the label, so it is focusable and operable by keyboard (no visible focus ring on the zone, minor).

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: Submit handler fills #successText with first + last name 'is ready to join ...' and calls dialog#success.showModal(), which moves focus into a modal dialog with a heading.

notes: Audit score 66: text-contrast x73 (muted text 4.04:1), 12px radii on section cards (5 radii), 12px body text, uppercase 'Draft' and 'Employee setup' labels. Headline 'Welcome someone new.' and the subtitle 'A great first day starts here' are greeting-style copy. Sidebar has a 'A little help?' tinted box but it is not a promo. Form is pre-filled with sample data, so the empty-state validation could not be seen. Bank and tax fields are all marked required but Account type, Filing status and Relationship selects have no required attribute.
